hero.subtitle: A free public tool for address checks and early exit-scam warnings — before it's too late.

about.title: About the project
about.p1: Turkey is one of the world's leading countries for retail crypto adoption — people have used crypto for years to protect savings from lira inflation.
about.p2: In 2021, the collapse of the Thodex exchange — its founder fled with roughly $2 billion — left around 400,000 users without their funds. There was no early warning: nobody saw the reserves draining before it was too late.
about.p3: Existing AML/forensics tools (Chainalysis, TRM, Crystal) are sold to exchanges for their own compliance — an ordinary depositor can't access them. Kalkan is a free public tool: paste an address → get a clear report, no signup required.

watchlistSection.title: Reserve wallet Watchlist
watchlistSection.subtitle: Real-time monitoring of reserves and outflows
watchlistSection.why: A demo of the early-detection mechanics, using major exchange reserve wallets (Binance, Bitfinex, Kraken) as examples. The same logic applies to any platform, including local Turkish exchanges.
